response.overview: Yevhen’s War is a documentary set in war-torn eastern Ukraine. It follows Yevhen Thachev, a Ukrainian volunteer who risks his life every day to evacuate elderly people and civilians trapped in villages near the front line. Despite constant danger from Russian drone attacks and the destruction around him, Yevhen continues his mission to save lives. At the same time, he struggles with the emotional pain of being separated from his wife, who has found refuge in Switzerland. Through his story, the documentary explores courage, sacrifice, humanity and hope in the midst of war.
response.title: La guerra di Yevhen
